title: Wolves Near Ashford
summary: Wolf sign has been found at the edge of Ashford: tracks too big for a dog and fences torn outward. Sander Stooks wants 2 of them dealt with.
offer_text: "The wolves have come closer to Ashford each night: howling closer every night. Go to the edge and thin them out, before someone is hurt."
turn_in_text: "Quieter already. I will sleep tonight. A little."

stages.title: Go to the edge of town

objectives.text: Go to where the wolves were seen
Tell Sander Stooks it is done

relationship.label: Kept the wolves from the edge
